selected_correction.name: Add current-rollout holding/recovery histories to the actor BC sampling pool
selected_correction.change: Replace half of each eligible class sample with training-rollout observations labeled by the unchanged causal teacher; retain half frozen demonstrations and fall back to frozen samples when a class is absent.
selected_correction.evidence: Premature HOLD decisions persist with high confidence on PPO-visited histories; original BC makes substantially fewer errors on those exact inputs. Existing imitation only samples three fixed demonstration trajectories.
selected_correction.qualification: Targets actor/history drift; physical slip reduction is a hypothesis, not established causation.
selected_correction.next_contract: New contract required; actor initialization from original BC with fresh critic/optimizer; no checkpoint extension
selected_correction.leakage_guard: Teacher sees only training pre-action cue state and executed scale. Never train on these evaluation seeds or use physical position as an actor input.

limitations: Physical-profile/route/seed conditions match, but contact/sensor stochasticity and cue events differ.
Event pairs are mutual nearest physical onsets within 0.30 m; unmatched events stay in the full-course scoring.
Spatial energy allocation assumes uniform interval energy along each short displacement; not raw per-sample slip.
Phase exposures differ; pooled phase differences do not prove causal attribution.
Offline original-BC replay does not predict a counterfactual physical trajectory.
No new pilot or Optuna launched; the original failed promotion gate remains unchanged.
